entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return these horrible cycling shoes. This is completely unacceptable. I've been a customer for years and I've never had such a terrible product.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

The issue? The issue is they're garbage! They gave me massive blisters after one ride. ONE RIDE. And the placement for the cleats feels totally off. I want a refund, and I want it now. Don't waste my time.

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I just need to pull up your order to verify the return eligibility. Do you have the order number handy?
Just look it up with my phone number! If you can't do this, get me your manager. I'm about to leave a review on every website I can find about this whole ordeal.
I can certainly look it up with your phone number, not a problem at all. One moment please... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes, placed 48 days ago. I'm just checking our policy.
48 days, 50 days, I don't care. Your website says 90 days. Are you going to honor your own policy or do I need to speak to someone who can?

You are absolutely correct. The cycling shoes fall under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you are well within that timeframe, I can process a full refund for you right away. I've just initiated that for you.
Oh. Okay. So you're actually going to give me the refund?

Yes, of course. I've approved the return, and I am now sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address we have on file. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, the refund will be credited to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Good. That's what I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience in the future. Have a good day.
